text.content:
Not a gang so much as a plague.

Turf: Anywhere dark
Known for: Ripping out implants and organs to sell
Allies & rivals: Nobody makes friends with the Scavengers. Maelstrom hunts them for sport

Scavengers work in small cells all over the city for as long as a leader can hold one together. They care only about profit, and they make it by cutting cyberware and organs out of people and selling them to shady ripperdocs and fixers. Rust Choir kids that Maelstrom doesn't pick tend to end up on a Scavenger's table.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.26; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.04
